items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: That's right, Ron. Ain't that right, Ron?

ctx.x: We played at a couple of hotels. Mont Leon. For different sororities, you know, like that. Yes. You say he went to Clayton. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
You only just started using the bass horn about 927? That's right, Ron. Ain't that right, Ron? It's around 26 or 27, something like that.

Then everybody wanted to change? Everybody, everybody. All the bands was with bass. They told you your bass, your string bass is old-fashioned. I know men that were... What famous bass violin players went on tubas, like Henry Kimball, Jimmy Johnson. All those fellas were playing tubas at that time.
